admin_launch_expired: This link from Moodle has expired. Open the organizer activity in Moodle again.
admin_embedded_text: Moodle opened this inside its own page, where your browser won't keep you signed in. Continue in a tab of its own.
admin_open_from_lms_text: Organizers get in by opening the organizer activity in their Moodle course. There is nothing to sign in with here.
scans_address_hint: The start of a check value of the IP address, not the address itself. The same value means the same address, but only within this event.
scans_host_hint: Recorded automatically: someone scanned the attendance QR code this admin was showing
scans_lti_hint: Opened the Moodle activity and scanned the code from the page it opened, rather than with a linked phone
scans_manual_entry_hint: Name and email were entered by hand after scanning the code. The app can't verify it was really this person – make sure this was agreed with them (e.g. because of problems with Moodle).
scans_shared_browser_hint: This browser was used to confirm attendance for more than one person
scans_other_phone_hint: Entered by hand on a phone that is linked to {name}
attendance_manual_hint: {count} of their {total} scans were entered by hand, which the app can't verify
attendance_flagged_hint: The scan log flags at least one of their scans: same browser as someone else, or another attendee's phone
link_hint: Moves this person's scans for this event to the Moodle account. They stay marked as manual entries.
link_failed: Couldn't link these scans: the Moodle account is gone, or it already has one of the same scans.
scans_shared_hint: More than one attendee scanned from this address
scans_again_hint: This attendee had already scanned earlier
scans_footnote: Neither flag is wrong on its own — attendees step out and come back, and many share one hotspot. A code that leaked looks like many attendees on one address who were never there in person.
events_never_synced: The calendar hasn't been synced yet.
events_sync_failed: The calendar couldn't be fetched. The server log has the details.
events_no_calendar: No calendar connected (CALENDAR_ICS_URL is not set). Events can be created here by hand.
unconfirmed_hint: Typed in their details by hand and not linked to an account yet, so they don't count as attended
events_help_purpose: Each event has its own QR code. Whoever scans it attended that event.
events_help_calendar: Taken over automatically. Edit them in the calendar only; “{sync}” fetches changes right away.
events_help_manual: Create with “{newEvent}”, edit with the pencil icon.
events_help_scans: The first scan counts as scanning in, the last as scanning out. For example, scans at 9:00, 12:00 and 17:00 mean scanned in at 9:00 and out at 17:00. A single scan only counts as scanning in.
events_help_scans_typed: The app can't check details typed in by hand. They only count once an organizer confirms which Moodle account they belong to (“{link}” on the event's page).
events_help_scans_kept: An event with scans can't be deleted. If it disappears from the calendar, it stays, marked “{removed}”.
events_removed_hint: No longer in the calendar, but it has scans, so it is kept
events_edit_calendar: Edit in the calendar (opens a new tab)
events_edit_calendar_unlinked: From the calendar: edit it there.
events_delete_blocked: This event already has scans, so it can't be deleted.
events_delete_calendar: From the calendar: delete it there. Deleted here, it would come back at the next sync.
events_delete_text: "{title}" will be deleted. This can't be undone.
events_missing: This event no longer exists, or it comes from the calendar.
event_form_invalid: That isn't a valid date and time.
event_form_before_start: The end has to be after the start.
code_pick_none: There is no event between yesterday and a month from now. Create one on the events page.
attendance_footnote: A person's first scan counts as scanning in, their last as scanning out — if there are at least two. Scans in between count as neither.
qr_keep_open: This code changes automatically — leave this page open.
scan_in_note: When you leave, you can scan the code again to scan out.
scan_out_note: If you scan again later, the newer scan counts as your scan-out.
scan_already_text: Since {time}: your first scan worked, no need to scan again.
scan_out_early_note: Didn't mean to scan out? No problem, just scan again later: the last scan counts.
scan_prompt_text: This page opens when you scan the attendance QR code. The code changes every 30 seconds, so scan the one showing now.
scan_set_up_heading: The attendance tool doesn't know this browser (yet)
scan_set_up_text: Open the attendance activity in your Moodle course and scan the code from the page it opens. Set up this browser there too, and next time this is all it takes.
scan_expired: This code has expired. Scan the one showing now.
scan_not_confirmed: We could not confirm that was you. Try again.
scan_event_gone: This event no longer exists. Ask the organizers to open the code again.
scan_not_set_up: The attendance tool doesn't know this browser (any more). Open the attendance activity in Moodle and scan the code from the page it opens.
scan_manual_hint: Can't scan at all? Confirm your attendance by hand
scan_manual_text: Only use this as a last resort, and only if the organizers have agreed you can confirm your attendance this way. If they haven't, contact them first. Use the email address you use in Moodle, so your attendance can be matched to you.
scan_manual_invalid: Please fill in all fields with a valid email address.
scan_manual_used: This scan has already been used to confirm someone's attendance. Scan the code again.
scan_manual_note: You confirmed with your details, so the organizers may check this entry.
enroll_open_from_moodle_text: Open the attendance activity in your Moodle course. It sends you here, ready to set up this phone.
enroll_scan_prompt: Point your camera at the attendance QR code.
enroll_scan_not_ours: That isn't the attendance QR code. Scan the one showing now.
enroll_camera_failed: We couldn't use the camera. Allow this site to use it, and try again.
enroll_camera_failed_embedded: Moodle's page may not let us use the camera. Continue in a new tab and scan there.
enroll_scan_expired: This page is too old to record your scan. Open the attendance activity in Moodle again, then scan.
enroll_key_create_failed: This browser couldn't be set up. If you're in a private window, try a normal one.
enroll_key_save_failed: This browser couldn't be set up. If you're in a private window, try a normal one.
enroll_problem_no_profile: Moodle didn't tell us your name and email address, which we need to set you up. Let the organizers know: the activity's privacy settings in Moodle need to share both.
enroll_problem_unknown_tool: This Moodle activity isn't set up yet. Let the organizers know: the tool has to be registered with the attendance tool first.
enroll_expired: This setup link has expired or was already used. Open the attendance activity in Moodle again.
enroll_bad_key: Something went wrong creating the key. Try again.
attendees_intro: Everyone who has opened either Moodle activity, organizers included, and everyone who entered their details by hand. Sorted by last launch, those who haven't come for a long time are at the top.
attendees_manual_hint: Entered their name and email by hand instead of opening the Moodle activity. Not a Moodle account: first and last launch are their first and latest entry.
attendees_none: Nobody has opened either Moodle activity yet.
attendees_delete_text: {name} ({email}) will be deleted, along with their linked phone. Their scans stay, without a name, for the events' statistics. This can't be undone; if they open the activity in Moodle again, they are created anew.
attendees_deleted: Deleted. Their scans are anonymous now.
home_not_linked_heading: The attendance tool doesn't know this browser (yet)
home_not_linked_text: Open the attendance activity in your Moodle course in this browser and set it up there. After that, you can see your attendance here without Moodle.
home_expired: This page has expired. Reload it.
attendance_none: No scans yet. Once you scan the attendance QR code at an event, it shows up here.

match.countPlural=one: When you scanned in and out at {count} event
match.countPlural=*: When you scanned in and out at {count} events

attendance_method_manual_linked: Typed in, assigned by an organizer
attendance_help_details: Tap an event to see all its scans.
attendance_help_missing: If you scanned only once, you're scanned in but not out. Scan the code again when you leave.
attendance_help_rule: Your first scan at an event counts as your scan-in, your last as your scan-out. Scans in between count for neither.
enroll_scan_option_text: Scan the attendance QR code with this page
enroll_linked: This browser is set up: at the event, your camera is all it takes to scan.
enroll_bookmark: You can see your attendance without Moodle at this address. Bookmark it:
enroll_linked_elsewhere: Another browser is already set up for you, on another device, or this one before its data was cleared.
enroll_setup_card_text: Scanning with your camera and your attendance, without Moodle
enroll_setup_card_elsewhere: Another browser is already set up for you
enroll_setup_intro: Set up this browser once. After that:
enroll_setup_benefit_scan: your camera is all it takes to scan at the event
enroll_setup_benefit_view: you can see your attendance at {address}
enroll_setup_what: Your browser creates a key the attendance tool recognises it by, and stores it. To undo it, clear the site data or set up another browser.
enroll_setup_warning: CAUTION: Anyone using this browser sees your attendance. So only set it up on your own device.
enroll_setup_done_text: At the event, your camera is now all it takes to scan.
enroll_link_browser: Use the one that opens when you scan a QR code with your camera, usually Safari on an iPhone, Chrome on Android.
enroll_link_here_note: The other one stops working then.
enroll_embedded_link: Moodle opened this inside its own page, where your browser won't keep the setup. Continue in a tab of its own.
enroll_page_expired: This page has expired. Open the attendance activity in Moodle again.
